questions.text: Which king of Persia made a proclamation throughout his realm to build the house of God?

options.text: King Darius, who set in order the government of the realm
King Artaxerxes, who reigned in Shushan the palace
King Ahasuerus, who ruled over an hundred provinces
King Cyrus of Persia, whom the LORD stirred up in spirit

questions.text: What did king Cyrus bring forth out of Babylon unto the returning captivity?

options.text: The vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar took
The original tables of the covenant brought from mount Sinai
The ivory thrones of the ancient kings that ruled in Jerusalem
The golden armours of war out of the royal armory of David

questions.text: Who rose up to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem?

options.text: Only the wealthy possessors of lands out of the tribe of Judah
All them whose spirit God had raised, to go up and build the house
Only those men of valour that were numbered unto the war
The Babylonian craftsmen whom Cyrus sent as captive workmen

questions.text: Who were the chief leaders of the children of the province that went up out of captivity?

options.text: Ezra the priest and scribe with Nehemiah the royal cupbearer
The prophet Daniel in his old age with the companions of court
Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the priest
Mordecai with the royal messengers of the palace of Shushan

questions.text: How many was the whole congregation together of them that returned out of captivity?

options.text: Twelve thousand chosen warriors, beside women and little ones
Two hundred and fifty thousand souls out of the twelve tribes
Seven thousand men that were all of the holy tribe of Levi
Forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore persons

questions.text: Why were certain sons of the priests put from the priesthood as polluted?

options.text: Because their genealogy was not found, therefore were they put out
Because they had taken strange wives during captivity in Babylon
Because they refused to offer burnt offerings according to the law
Because they brought no silver unto the treasury of the house

questions.text: What did Jeshua and Zerubbabel build first of all in the seventh month?

options.text: The broad walls and gates of Jerusalem to defend from enemies
The altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon
The royal palace buildings for the ruler of the province
A great storehouse for the tithes of the corn and new wine

questions.text: What song of praise was sung when the builders laid the foundation of the temple?

options.text: The LORD is King of kings and will break the horns of the heathen
Great is king Cyrus of Persia who hath delivered us out of bonds
Because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel
Awake, awake, put on thy beautiful garments, O holy Jerusalem

questions.text: Why was the noise of the shout of joy mingled with the noise of the weeping?

options.text: Because the adversaries out of Samaria assaulted them with arms
Because the cedar trees from Lebanon were sunken in the great sea
Because the people lacked silver to pay the masons and carpenters
Because many of ancient men, that had seen the first house, wept aloud

questions.text: How answered Zerubbabel and Jeshua when the adversaries offered to build with them?

options.text: Ye have nothing to do with us to build; but we ourselves will build
They accepted their help and divided the labor of the sanctuary
They demanded a great tribute of silver before they should build
They appealed unto the governor of the province beyond the river

questions.text: What accusation did the adversaries write unto Artaxerxes against Jerusalem?

options.text: The Jews were preparing weapons of war to invade all provinces
If this city be builded, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom
The Jewish builders had profaned the ancient sepulchres of kings
They intended to dedicate the holy temple unto the gods of Canaan

questions.text: Until what time ceased the work of the house of God at Jerusalem?

options.text: Until the expedition of king Cyrus against the realm of Grecia
Until the walls of the city of Samaria were overthrown by quake
Unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia
Until Ezra the scribe arrived at Zion with a company of soldiers

questions.text: Which two prophets prophesied unto the Jews to restart the building of the house?

options.text: Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo
Elijah and Elisha prophesying along river Jordan
Jeremiah the prophet and his faithful scribe Baruch
Micah the Morasthite and the prophet Habakkuk

questions.text: Which governor on this side the river came and questioned the Jews concerning the building?

options.text: Sanballat the governor of the neighbouring province of Samaria
Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai
Haman the Agagite, the chief prince of the palace of the king
Potiphar the captain of the royal guard stationed at the border

questions.text: Why could the adversaries NOT cause the elders of the Jews to cease from building?

options.text: Because Zerubbabel commanded a mighty garrison of horsemen
Because the walls of the city were already strongly fortified
Because the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews
Because Tatnai secretly believed in the God of heaven and earth

questions.text: Where was found the roll containing the original decree of Cyrus concerning the house?

options.text: In the palace gardens of the royal city of Shushan by river
Within the ark of covenant hidden in the sanctuary of Zion
In the treasure house of the ancient city of Babylon of old
At Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Medes

questions.text: What did king Darius command Tatnai and his companions concerning the house of God?

options.text: Let the work alone; and of the king's goods let expenses be given
Carry away all the builders of the temple as servants to Persia
Break down the altar and erect a palace for the Persian governor
Shut the gates of Jerusalem and suffer no timber to be brought in

questions.text: When was the house finished, and how did the children of Israel keep the dedication?

options.text: On the tenth day of the seventh month with a solemn fast of soul
On the third day of the month Adar in sixth year of Darius with joy
On the first day of the month Nisan at coronation of Zerubbabel
At the feast of weeks with bitter lamentation for its smallness

questions.text: Under which king of Persia did Ezra go up from Babylon unto Jerusalem?

options.text: Under Cyrus the king immediately following the first proclamation
Under Darius the Mede in the first year of his realm in Chaldea
Under king Artaxerxes in the seventh year of his royal reign
Under Ahasuerus following the great war against the Greeks

questions.text: What holy purpose prepared the heart of Ezra the priest and scribe?

options.text: To gather weapons of war for the defence of the mountains of Judah
To demand solemn oaths of personal allegiance from all the people
To obtain high offices of honour in the royal court of the palace
To seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach statutes

questions.text: What authority did king Artaxerxes confer upon Ezra the scribe in his decree?

options.text: To set magistrates and judges, to teach the law, and execute judgment
To build a navy of ships upon the great sea against all adversaries
To pull down every heathen altar and take their treasures for himself
To crown himself king over all the province beyond the river

questions.text: What did Ezra view when he viewed the people and the priests by river of Ahava?

options.text: That no man among them had brought sword or shield for the way
That he found there none of the sons of Levi among the people
That a multitude of the men were stricken with sore sickness
That the ambassadors had lost the royal letters of the Persian king

questions.text: Why proclaimed Ezra a fast at the river of Ahava, instead of requiring soldiers?

options.text: Because king Artaxerxes had strictly forbidden him horsemen
Because the journey lay through waterless deserts without bread
Because he was ashamed to require a band of soldiers, trusting in God
Because strange soldiers would have polluted the holy temple court

questions.text: How was the great weight of silver, gold, and holy vessels kept during the way?

options.text: In heavy iron chests guarded by hired horsemen of the wilderness
In secret barrels marked as flour for the daily meat offerings
Upon river boats steered silently by night along the channels
It was weighed into the hands of twelve chief of the priests

questions.text: What great trespass did the princes declare unto Ezra when he was come to Jerusalem?

options.text: The people and priests had not separated themselves from the lands
The merchants refused to deliver the tithes of the wine and corn
The Levites offered sacrifices in secret upon the ancient hills
Certain princes purposed to return into the cities of Babylon

questions.text: What did Ezra when he heard this thing concerning the holy seed?

options.text: He called for the Persian garrison to lay hands upon the transgressors
He rent his garment and mantle, plucked off his hair, and sat astonied
He departed immediately from Jerusalem and returned unto Shushan
He wrote a letter unto the king desiring that all priests be removed

questions.text: What did Ezra confess in his prayer at the evening sacrifice with spread hands?

options.text: That the people were without fault and led astray by strange nations
That the destruction of the first temple had been too severe a plague
That our iniquities are increased over our head unto the heavens
That new burnt sacrifices would make an instant atonement for all

questions.text: What counsel did Shechaniah give unto Ezra concerning the strange wives?

options.text: That all the guilty men should be banished ten years unto Egypt
That the foreign wives should be consecrated for service in temple
That the matter should be referred unto the decree of the king
To make a covenant with our God to put away all the strange wives

questions.text: In what manner were all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem?

options.text: They sat in the street of the house of God, trembling for great rain
They stood beneath the covered porches of the court in the summer
They encamped in the plains of Jericho to escape the cold mountains
They shut themselves within the strong towers for fear of robbers

questions.text: How was the matter of the strange wives examined and ended by the rulers?

options.text: Every man determined the matter secretly in his own dwellingplace
The chief of the fathers sat down to examine, and made an end by first month
Persian governors were appointed to try every case in the judgment
The holy lot was cast at the altar upon each separate household
